characters.name: The Courier
characters.design: Satin chrome capsule body, black spherical head, two amber eyes, two angular folded metal wings with dark ribs, no human face or costume.
characters.carriedObject: One warm amber time capsule within a silver equatorial ring.

worldRule: A glowing second can be carried and returned to monumental mechanical clocks.
continuity: The courier returns the captured second and liberates the clock. Future episodes need their own situation and staging.
